name: Variable Expansion and Chain Deduction
description: The original variables S_i and U_i are expanded by introducing explicit end-time variables E_i and V_i. The single-inequality constraints are replaced by a chain of equalities and inequalities (e.g., E_i - S_i = p_{1,i}, E_i <= U_i, V_i - U_i = p_{2,i}, V_i <= T). This forces the model to perform algebraic substitution to deduce the fundamental p_1 + p_2 > T and sum(p) > T conditions, breaking surface-level pattern matching on the standard interval scheduling formulation.
